name: chriha
description: Christopher Hartmann's Claude Code plugins: ticket pipeline, project setup wizard and guided MR/PR review.

plugins.name: harness
plugins.description: Ticket pipeline (/harness:work, /harness:ticket, /harness:review, ...) with per-project overrides, stack packs and adapters.

plugins.name: project
plugins.description: /project:setup interviews you and writes PROJECT_PLAN.md; /project:update plans the gaps of an existing project; /project:build executes it.

plugins.name: tour
plugins.description: Guided MR/PR review: /tour:review groups a change into chapters, explains each and opens a local web UI (in development).
